title: Flix Retired Vocabulary Schema
description: Schema for ast/retired.json: vocabulary the reference once defined and has since removed. Hand-maintained, because nothing in the current jar can say what used to be in an older one. This is to vocabulary what retired-versions.json is to published coordinates -- the record that survives a removal, so a consumer can learn that a kind is gone by name rather than by a digest that merely stopped matching.

reason.description: Why it went, and what a consumer should do about it. Long enough to force an argument rather than an assertion.
